summary: A setback can start sounding like a verdict on your ability when you have already tied too much of your confidence to getting this one thing right.
body: A setback can start sounding like a verdict on your ability when you have already tied too much of your confidence to getting this one thing right. When the Sun squares Saturn, delays, criticism, responsibility, or a hard practical limit can make you question yourself more harshly than the situation actually requires. Something may need more time, a smaller scope, or a different approach, but that is not the same as being incapable. Work with the limit in front of you without turning it into evidence that you should expect less from yourself.
